name: Arc Totem Hierophant
summary: The Tendrils totem is the default link: Lightning Tendrils of Eccentricity channels a semicircle in front of the totem, and every fifth pulse is stronger (a much larger area and an automatic critical strike). Marylene's Fallacy multiplies that guaranteed critical strike into the boss hit and Lioneye's Remorse is the armour and life behind the flasks; Arc sits in the four-link helmet for open layouts. The measured damage is per totem. Both required uniques are cheap common drops; there is no expensive required unique.

pros.text: Two totems clear and boss from one six-link body, and the stronger pulse does the boss damage.
The required uniques are cheap: a Lapis Amulet and a strength shield, both common drops.
Lioneye's Remorse, Determination, the flasks and the endurance charges give the life pool a real physical layer.
Totems channel while you move, so positioning is far less punishing than self-cast.
No expensive required unique; the pinnacle bill is the six-link, the 21/20 gems and the Awakened supports, with Awakened Empower the priciest.
Arc chains to a whole pack, so the clear swap needs no aiming.

cons.text: Both totems must survive the whole fight; area damage deletes them and the damage stops.
The default link needs a transfigured gem from the Divine Font or trade, and the pinnacle damage needs an Awakened Empower.
Clear is a totem's clear, not a bow build's; you walk between packs and wait for placement.
Blasphemy, Determination and Clarity leave only a few casts of unreserved mana; the mana flask is part of the rotation.
Two uniques are required for the measured red-map and pinnacle sets; they are cheap but they are not optional.
The tree's fire and cold walkers are planner artifacts with dead damage lines.

sub.watch: Spell Totem and Lightning Penetration replace Controlled Destruction and Arcane Surge in the four-link; a second Spell Totem setup for Arc moves to the helmet, and Determination comes online. The fifth link waits for 68 and the sixth for red maps.

notes: First guide for the Covens league.
The default link is Lightning Tendrils of Eccentricity on Spell Totems: its wide pulse clears and its stronger pulse bosses. Arc keeps the four-link helmet for open layouts.
The gate report measures the default link at red maps and pinnacle; the published paste holds both links, and the four-link Arc is the clear swap.
Lightning Tendrils, self-cast and then on Spell Totem, carries the campaign; the transfigured version takes over at the Merciless Labyrinth.
Arcane Blessing and Blasphemy with Conductivity are the damage layers; Determination, a Granite flask, a Basalt flask and Conviction of Power are the physical layer.
The tree buys life first; chaos resistance reaches 75% at pinnacle only, and every checkpoint passes the standard floors rather than the lower Dad damage floor.
Withdrew the S+: the gate had measured level-16 Awakened supports and Empower, and the game caps Awakened supports at 5 and Awakened Empower at 4. The late links now cap those levels explicitly.
On legal gems pinnacle measures 295k per totem and red maps 187k per totem; every checkpoint still passes its standard floor.
Ratings are 10/8/8/9 and the medal is S: tankiness stays 10 on 46.0k EHP and 14.1k max hit, while single target and clear drop to 8.
Two cheap common-drop uniques are required at red maps and pinnacle; the leveling steps stay unique-free, and the bill is the six-link, the 21/20 gems and the Awakened supports.
A 28-38 step now shows the four-link and the gems that unlock at 38; the fifth link waits for 68 and the sixth for red maps.

summary.text: Arc Totem Hierophant runs Lightning Tendrils of Eccentricity on two Spell Totems as its default clear and boss link, with Marylene's Fallacy multiplying the stronger pulse's guaranteed critical strike and Lioneye's Remorse for the armour, and keeps Arc in a four-link helmet for open layouts. The measured link runs 186.8k at red maps and 294.6k at pinnacle per totem. The channel covers a semicircle in front of the totem, and every fifth pulse is stronger (a much larger area and an automatic critical strike), so the same link clears packs and delivers the boss hit. No expensive unique is required.

leveling.text: Level with Rolling Magma, then self-cast Lightning Tendrils: the channel hits harder than self-cast Arc before the totem links, and it is the same skill the default link upgrades. The first checkpoint measures 377 life and 49 damage; the second measures 773 damage. Put the Tendrils on Spell Totem, put Arc in the helmet as a three-link alongside the totem body, transfigure a Tendrils at the Divine Font in the Merciless Labyrinth for the upgraded version, and add Faster Casting when the helmet becomes a four-link at red maps.

maps.text: At red maps the default link measures 186.8k per totem with 32338 effective life and 12279 physical max hit. It runs Concentrated Effect for that number, so swap the support for Increased Area of Effect (or use the Arc helmet) when a pack is spread; the swap costs some damage, and the Arc helmet's damage is not measured here. This is the step where the uniques arrive: Marylene's Fallacy multiplies the guaranteed critical strike on the stronger pulse into the boss hit and Lioneye's Remorse is the armour and life behind the flasks. The channel covers a semicircle in front of the totem, so the totem clears the pack it is placed in; Arc swaps into the four-link helmet when an open layout wants a chain. Blasphemy with Conductivity is the damage aura, and Determination with a Granite and a Basalt flask is the physical layer. Cap the elemental resistances and keep both Tendrils totems ahead of you; the Arc helmet shares the two-totem cap, so carrying it costs one Tendrils totem. The week-one budget covers the rares; the paste's Awakened support and Empower are trade or drop gems, and the solo-self-found substitutes are not measured, so expect less than this number. The tree's fire and cold walkers are planner artifacts: their damage and cast-speed lines are fire/cold-scoped, so a hand-built tree should cut them for a lightning or life cluster.

bossing.text: Pinnacle measures 294.6k per totem with 46037 effective life and 14062 physical max hit. Place both Tendrils totems before the burst (they expire on a timer, so recast them before they run out) and keep Conductivity on the boss. Replace a totem after every phase that clears the arena; the stronger pulse is the damage window, so the totem has to be channelling before the boss commits to a slam. Awakened Empower in the six-link is the pinnacle damage bill; the red-map paste uses the regular support and keeps the import cheap. Awakened Elemental Focus cannot inflict ailments, so this link does not shock; the red-map link can.
